hero.label: About
hero.heading: Behind Baghlabs
hero.subtitle: A small studio with a background across marketing, project management and software. Three disciplines that do not usually travel together.

story.heading: The background
story.intro: Most studios pick a lane. Baghlabs works across a few, because the problems clients bring rarely fit just one.

pillars.label: Marketing
pillars.title: Where the work started
pillars.description: Campaigns, positioning, ad strategy across different sectors. The lesson that kept coming up: most marketing problems are not marketing problems. Brief, audience, timing - those are where things actually break. That is the level the work happens at.

pillars.label: Management
pillars.title: Keeping things on track
pillars.description: Projects go sideways for familiar reasons. Scope that grows without a conversation, decisions that do not get made, things that should have been said earlier. Spotting those patterns and doing something about them is part of the job here.

pillars.label: Software
pillars.title: Built in-house
pillars.description: The code is written here, not handed off. That means estimates are based on what the work actually takes, and the back-and-forth stays short.

network.label: How it works
network.heading: When more people are needed
network.description: Some projects call for more than one discipline. There is a small trusted circle of professionals that I as Baghlabs work with regularly. When they are needed, they join the project. You will know who is involved and what they are doing.
network.note: People with a shared track record, not sourced from a platform.

testimonials.subtitle: A few words from people we have worked with.
